title: Pointer to the properties of [def-trf-categorical-trace]
text:
In the notation of [def-trf-categorical-trace], the following holds. The
explicit model-level formulas for $\operatorname{coev}_P$ and
$\operatorname{ev}_P$, the verification of the triangle identities,
and the Koszul sign convention of the symmetric monoidal structure
(the braiding $\operatorname{sym}_{P,Q}:P\otimes_A^LQ\xrightarrow{\sim} Q\otimes_A^LP$, $p\otimes q\mapsto(-1)^{|p||q|}q\otimes p$) are
given in [lem-trf-chain-supertrace], whose statement is the
derived-category consequence (the supertrace formula).
